blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Tabular learning uses structured data to predict target outcomes. Traditionally, this process has relied on labeled data. However, large language models (LLMs) can be used to elicit domain priors based on the task description and feature semantics, thereby enabling predictions without labeled data. We propose Ma rginal R esponse S urface Elicitation (MARS), a method that transforms feature-level LLM priors into a reusable, zero-shot tabular classifier. To construct this classifier, MARS selects representative values for each feature from unlabeled data and prompts the LLM to provide corresponding class support scores and feature weights. It then aggregates multiple responses using the median to construct feature response functions, and makes predictions through their weighted sum without further LLM queries. Across eight tabular benchmark tasks, MARS achieves the highest average AUC and AP, outperforming direct prompting by 1.97 and 6.21 percentage points respectively, while substantially reducing end-to-end costs. Evaluations with LLMs of different sizes further demonstrate its predictive advantage over direct prompting. Keywords: Large language models, tabular learning, zero-label prediction
blocks.zh: 表格学习使用结构化数据来预测目标结果. 传统上,这一过程依赖于被标记的数据. 然而,大型语言模型(LLMs)可以用来根据任务描述和特征语义来获取域前缀,从而使得没有被标记的数据的预测成为可能. 我们提出 Ma rginal R esponse S urface Election (MARS),一种将特征级LLM前缀转换成可重复使用,零镜头的表格分类器的方法. 要构造这个分类器,MARS从无标签的数据中选择每个特性的代表性值,并提示LLM提供相应的类支持分和特征权重. 然后,它利用中位数汇总多个响应来构建特征响应函数,并通过它们的加权和数进行预测,不再进行LLM查询. 在8个表格基准任务中,MARS实现了最高的AUC和AP平均,表现分别比1.97和6.21个百分点直接快,同时大幅减少了端到端的费用. 采用不同规模的有限责任管理办法进行的评价进一步表明,它比直接提示具有预测优势。 关键词 : 大型语言模型、表格学习、零标签预测

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Tabular learning utilizes structured information recorded in tables to predict target outcomes, finding broad applications across customer analytics, credit assessment, and business operations ( Borisov et al., 2024 ; Hollmann et al., 2025 ; Gardner et al., 2024 ) . Traditional prediction pipelines rely heavily on labeled samples, using supervised training to learn the mapping relationships between features and labels ( Grinsztajn et al., 2022 ; Gorishniy et al., 2025 ; Erickson et al., 2025 ) . However, in many real-world business scenarios, the need for predictions often arises before actual business labels are available. For example, when a company launches a new product, it already has access to certain customer attributes and account information but needs to determine which customers to contact first before subscription results are available. This has given rise to the need for zero-label tabular prediction—that is, building a predictor using unlabeled records when the prediction target and feature meanings are known.
blocks.zh: 表格学习利用表格中记录的结构化信息预测目标结果,发现客户分析、信用评估和业务业务的广泛应用(Borisov等,2024;Holmann等,2025;Gardner等,2024)。 传统的预测管道严重依赖有标签的样品,利用有监督的培训来了解地物和标签之间的绘图关系(Grinsztajn等,2022;Gorishniy等,2025;Erickson等,2025)。 然而,在许多现实世界的商业情景中,在获得实际的商业标签之前,往往需要预测。 例如,当一家公司推出一款新产品时,它已经能够获取某些客户属性和账户信息,但需要在获得订阅结果之前先确定哪些客户联系. 这导致需要零标签表型预测——即当预测目标和特征含义已知时,利用无标签记录建立一个预测器.

blocks.en: The knowledge accumulated by large language models (LLMs) during pretraining can be combined with task objectives to provide priors for label-scarce tabular prediction ( Bordt et al., 2024 ; Capstick et al., 2025 ) . These priors are injected into the prediction pipeline in different ways: TabLLM ( Hegselmann et al., 2023 ) converts tabular records into text for direct prediction, CLLM ( Seedat et al., 2024 ) and SERSAL ( Yan et al., 2025 ) generate synthetic data and pseudo-labels to train the model, FeatLLM ( Han et al., 2024 ) generates rules and converts them into features to train a simple model, and LLM-Trees ( Knauer et al., 2025 ) and ProtoLLM ( Wang et al., 2025 ) generate decision trees and prototypes to make predictions.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)在预训期间所积累的知识可以与任务目标相结合,为标签-恐惧表预测提供前科(Bordt等,2024;Capstick等,2025.). 这些前科以不同方式被注入到预测管道中:TabLLM(Hegselmann等,2023年)将表格记录转换为文字进行直接预测,CLLM(Seedat等,2024年)和SERSAL(Yan等,2025年)生成合成数据和伪标签来训练模型,FeatLLM(Han等,2024年)生成规则并被转换成特征来训练一个简单的模型,而LLM-Trees(Knauer等,2025年)和ProtoLLLM(Wang等,2025年)生成决策树和原型来进行预测.

blocks.en: These methods raise a more fundamental question: What information can be leveraged in a few-shot setting? We distinguish between two types of information: ❶ the relationship between the value of a single feature and the class, and ❷ the additional information provided by cross-feature couplings. To guide which type of information to elicit from LLMs for zero-label prediction, we conduct a within-class column-wise permutation experiment ( Ojala and Garriga, 2010 ) on real-world datasets with labels. As illustrated in Figure 1 , we independently permute the values of each feature within each class, thereby preserving the marginal distribution of each feature within each class, but disrupting the original cross-feature pairings. We then train identical CatBoost models separately on the original and permuted data, and compare their performance on the same test set. We find that the average performance difference is close to zero for 4–16 training samples, suggesting that the model gains little additional predictive benefit from cross-feature couplings in this regime. This suggests prioritizing the relationship between individual feature values and the class when eliciting LLM priors, as priors on cross-feature relationships may be noisy in the absence of labels.
blocks.zh: 这些方法提出了一个更根本的问题: 在几发情况下可以利用哪些信息? 我们区分两种信息:QQ单个特征值与类的关系,和由跨地缘耦合提供的额外信息. 为了指导从LLMs中获取何种信息进行零标签预测,我们用标签在现实世界数据集上进行一列内穿插实验(Ojala和Garriga,2010年)。 如图1所示,我们独立地将每个特征的值固定在每个类内,从而保留每个特征在每个类内的边际分布,但会打乱原来的交叉地貌配对. 然后在原始和被渗透的数据上分别训练相同的CatBoost模型,并在同一套测试中比较它们的性能. 我们发现,4至16个培训样本的平均性能差差已接近于零,这表明该模型从这一制度中的交叉地貌组合中获得的额外预测效益很少。 这表明在引出LLM前传时优先处理单个特征值和类之间的关系,因为如果没有标签,交叉地物关系的前传可能很吵.

blocks.en: Based on this intuition, we propose Ma rginal R esponse S urface Elicitation (MARS), a method that transforms the domain priors of LLMs into a reusable zero-label predictor. MARS selects representative values for each feature from unlabeled data and, combining task descriptions with feature semantics, obtains class support scores for each value and weights for each feature. Subsequently, it constructs feature response functions through median aggregation and employs their weighted sum for prediction. The entire process requires no ground-truth labels or local model training, and predicting new samples does not require calling the LLM again.
blocks.zh: 基于这种直觉,我们提出Ma rginal R esponse S urface Election (MARS),这种方法将LLMs的域名前缀转换为可重复使用的零标签预测器. MARS从无标签的数据中选择每个特性的代表性值,并结合任务描述和特征语义,获得每个值的类支持分和每个特性的权重. 随后,它通过中位数汇总构建出特征反应功能,并使用它们的加权和来进行预测. 整个过程不需要地面真实的标签或本地模型训练,预测出新的样本不需要再次调用LLM.

blocks.en: Comprehensive experiments across tabular benchmarks and LLMs of different sizes show that MARS is ❶ powerful : MARS achieves the best average AUC and AP among all baselines, including direct LLM prompting; ❷ efficient : MARS does not require any LLM API calls during inference, with end-to-end API call costs amounting to only 9.6% of ProtoLLM; ❸ transferable : MARS achieves better average AUC and AP than direct prompting on both Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B. In summary, our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 跨表格基准的综合实验和不同规模的有限责任管理显示,MARS很强: MARS在所有基线中实现最佳平均AUC和AP,包括直接LLM提示; QQ高效: MARS在推论中不需要任何LLM API调用,端到端API调用费用仅为ProtoLLM的9.6%; QQ可转让 : MARS比直接促进Quen3.5-4B和Quen3.5-9B都更能实现平均AUC和AP. 总之,我们的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • Mechanistic Analysis: The average benefit of within-class column permutation is close to zero in the few-shot regime, providing direct empirical support for the hypothesis that the LLM prior is informative at the feature level, but not at the instance level. • Method Design: We propose MARS, which converts feature-level LLM priors into response functions through median aggregation and combines them via weighted summation into a reusable predictor requiring no ground-truth labels, local model training, or test-time LLM queries. • Experimental Evaluation: On eight benchmark tasks, MARS achieves 1.97/6.21 higher average AUC/AP than direct prompting while largely reducing end-to-end costs compared to other high-performing baselines; cross-model experiments further demonstrate the transferability of our method.
blocks.zh: • 机械分析: 类内纵列穿行的平均好处在几发制下接近于零,为LLM前作在特征层次上信息丰富的假设提供了直接的经验支持,但在实例层次上则没有. 二. 支助 方法设计 : 我们提出MARS,它通过中位聚合将地物级LLM前缀转换为响应函数,并通过加权总和将其组合成一个可重复使用的预测器,不需要地面真实标签,本地模型培训,或测试时间LLM查询. • 实验评价: 在8个基准任务上,MARS实现了1.97/6.21的平均数AUC/AP高于直接提示,同时与其他高性能基线相比,基本上降低了端到端成本;跨模型实验进一步证明了我们的方法的可转移性.

blocks.en: Experimental Evaluation: On eight benchmark tasks, MARS achieves 1.97/6.21 higher average AUC/AP than direct prompting while largely reducing end-to-end costs compared to other high-performing baselines; cross-model experiments further demonstrate the transferability of our method.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Few-shot tabular learning aims to achieve strong predictive performance with limited labeled data. To alleviate label scarcity, pretraining methods learn transferable feature representations from unlabeled data and adapt them to target tasks using a small number of labeled examples ( Yoon et al., 2020 ; Bahri et al., 2022 ; Nam et al., 2023 ) . Cross-task pretraining instead learns general predictive capabilities across large collections of tabular tasks and uses a few labeled examples as context to predict on new tasks ( Hollmann et al., 2025 ; Grinsztajn et al., 2026 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) . These approaches reduce target-task annotation requirements through pretraining, whereas we investigate how to leverage LLM domain knowledge to construct predictors without target-task labels.
blocks.zh: 少发即发表学习的目的是用有限的标注数据实现强的预测性能. 为了缓解标签的稀缺性,预训方法从未贴标签的数据中学习可转移的特征表示,并用少量被贴标签的例子使其适应目标任务(Yoon等,2020;Bahri等,2022;Nam等,2023)。 交叉任务预训则在大量表征任务中学习一般预测能力,并使用几个被标注为上下文的例子来预测新的任务(Holmann等,2025;Grinsztajn等,2026;Qu等,2026). 这些方法通过预训降低目标任务注释要求,而我们则研究如何利用LLM域知识构建没有目标任务标签的预测器.

blocks.en: LLMs can leverage task descriptions and feature semantics to apply domain knowledge acquired during pretraining to tabular prediction. Direct-inference methods represent tabular records as text and use LLMs to generate class predictions ( Hegselmann et al., 2023 ; Slack and Singh, 2023 ; Gardner et al., 2024 ) . Knowledge-transfer methods instead convert LLM knowledge into training data or feature representations for learning downstream predictors ( Seedat et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . Another line of work uses LLMs to construct or refine predictors, encoding prior knowledge as decision rules or class prototypes for subsequent local prediction ( Knauer et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . MARS transforms LLM domain knowledge into feature response functions and their weights, combining their weighted outputs into a reusable zero-label predictor. It requires neither downstream model training nor test-time LLM queries.
blocks.zh: LLMS可以利用任务描述和特征语义,将预训期间获得的域知识应用到表型预测. 直接推算法代表了表格式记录为正文并使用LLMs生成类预测(Hegselmann等,2023;Slack和Singh,2023;Gardner等,2024.). 知识转让方法将LLM知识转换为培训数据或用于学习下游预测器的特征说明(Seedat等人,2024年); Yan等,2025;Han等,2024;Shi等,2025;). 另一行工作采用LLMs构建或精炼预测器,将先前的知识编码为决策规则或类原型,用于随后的本地预测(Knauer等,2025;Ye等,2025;Wang等,2025)。 MARS将LLM域知识转换为特征响应函数及其权重,将加权输出组合为可再使用的零标签预测器. 它既不要求下游模式培训,也不要求测试时间LLM查询.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of MARS. MARS aggregates five LLM responses by the median and caches the resulting feature response functions and weights. New samples are scored by evaluating these functions at their feature values and summing the weighted responses.
blocks.zh: 图2:MARS概览. MARS按中位数汇总了5个LLM响应,并缓存由此产生的特征响应功能和权重. 新的样本通过按其特征值评估这些功能并总结加权反应来打分。

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates the overall pipeline of MARS. MARS first selects representative values for each feature from unlabeled reference data (Section 3.1 ), and then prompts the LLM with the task description and feature semantics to obtain a support score for each value and a feature weight (Section 3.2 ). Subsequently, MARS aggregates multiple responses to construct reusable feature response functions. When predicting new samples, it computes each feature’s response via numerical interpolation or categorical lookup tables, and then aggregates the scores using the feature weights to obtain a final prediction score, without querying the LLM (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 图2显示了最低运作标准的总体管道。 MARS首先从无标签的参考数据中选择每个特性的代表性值(第3.1节),再用任务描述和特征语义来提示LLM,以获得每个值的支持分和特征权重(第3.2节). 随后,MARS汇总多个响应来构建可再使用的特征响应功能. 在预测新的样本时,它通过数值插值或断然取出表来计算每个特征的反应,然后用特征权重来汇总分数以获得最后的预测分数,而不询问LLM(第3.3节).

blocks.en: 3.1 Representative Value Selection
blocks.zh: 3.1 代表性价值选择

blocks.en: Tabular features are either numerical or categorical. For a numerical feature, MARS computes the empirical quantiles at { 0.05 , 0.20 , 0.35 , 0.50 , 0.65 , 0.80 , 0.95 } \{0.05,0.20,0.35,0.50,0.65,0.80,0.95\} using the non-missing values in U U and removes duplicates to obtain at most seven anchors. For a categorical feature, MARS stores up to 20 of the most frequent values and their frequencies. The feature name, type, and anchors are then sent to the LLM together with the task description.

blocks.en: 3.2 Marginal Response Elicitation
blocks.zh: 3.2 边际反应

blocks.en: MARS combines the task and feature descriptions into a single prompt and formulates the binary classification task as a yes/no question where “yes” represents the positive class. We query the LLM R = 5 R=5 times using the same prompt, covering all features each time, and ask the LLM to first explain the meaning of the positive class and provide typical examples in 1–2 sentences before scoring each feature.
blocks.zh: MARS将任务和特征描述合并成一个单一的即时,并将二进制分类任务作为 " 是 " 代表正类的 " 是/否 " 问题来表述。 我们使用相同的提示查询 LLM R = 5 R = 5 次,每次覆盖所有特性,并要求 LLM 首先解释正类的意义,并在1–2句中提供典型的例子,然后对每个特性进行评分.

blocks.en: In the r r -th response, the LLM provides a support score z j ​ ℓ ( r ) ∈ [ − 3 , 3 ] z_{j\ell}^{(r)}\in[-3,3] for each anchor a j ​ ℓ a_{j\ell} of feature j j . Positive, negative, and zero values represent support for the positive class, negative class, and neutrality, respectively, while the absolute value indicates support strength. The prompt requires that all features use a uniform log-odds scale, where + 1 +1 and − 1 -1 approximately correspond to multiplying and dividing the odds of the positive class by e e , respectively.

Unlike the support scores assigned to individual values, this score is uniform across the entire feature and is subsequently used to calculate the global weight.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Tasks and Benchmarks. Following FeatLLM ( Han et al., 2024 ) and ProtoLLM ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , we evaluate MARS on eight tabular benchmark tasks covering financial services (Bank ( Moro et al., 2011 ) , Credit-G ( Hofmann, 1994 ) ), healthcare (Blood ( Yeh et al., 2009 ) , Diabetes ( Smith et al., 1988 ) , Heart ( fedesoriano, 2021 ) , Myocardial ( Golovenkin et al., 2020 ) , NHANES ( NA, 2019 ) ), and agriculture (Cultivars ( de Oliveira et al., 2023 ) ). The evaluation metrics are ROC-AUC (AUC) and average precision (AP).
blocks.zh: 任务和基准。 继FeatLLLM(Han等,2024年)和ProtoLLM(Wang等,2025年)之后,我们评价了MARS的8个表格基准任务,涵盖金融服务(Bank(Moro等,2011年),Credit-G(Hofmann,1994年)),保健(Bloud(Yeh等,2009年),糖尿病) (Smith等,1988年),"心"(Fedesoriano,2021年),"心". blocks.en: Baselines. We compare with three groups of baselines: (1) supervised learning , including LogReg, XGBoost ( Chen and Guestrin, 2016 ) , and CatBoost; (2) few-shot tabular learning , including STUNT ( Nam et al., 2023 ) , TabPFN-3 ( Grinsztajn et al., 2026 ) , TabICLv2 ( Qu et al., 2026 ) , TabFM ( Google Research, 2026 ) , DeLTa ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , and FeatLLM ( Han et al., 2024 ) ; (3) zero-label prediction , including Direct (direct LLM prompting), TabuLa-8B ( Gardner et al., 2024 ) , LLM-Trees ( Knauer et al., 2025 ) , and ProtoLLM ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . The first two groups of baselines are provided with 4 labeled examples (2 per class) for both training and model selection. The third group of baselines, as well as MARS, do not use any task-specific labels for prediction.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了三组基线:(1) 监督学习,包括LogReg、XGBoost(陈和Guestrin,2016年)和CatBoost;(2) 少发表学习,包括STUNT(Nam等,2023年),TabPFN-3(Grinsztajn等,2026年),TabICLv2(Qu等,2026年),TabFM(Google研究,2026年),DeLTa。 (Ye等人,2025年),和FeatLLM(Han等人,2024年);(3)零标签预测,包括直接(直接LLM提示),TabuLa-8B(Gardner等人,2024年),LLM-Trees(Knauer等人,2025年)和ProtoLLM. (王等,2025年) (中文(简体) ). 前两类基线有4个标有标签的例子(每班2个),用于培训和模型选择。 第三组基线以及MARS不使用任何特定任务标签进行预测.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. In the main experiments, we use DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 with high-intensity thinking as the backbone LLM. We also use Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B to compare MARS with Direct, with native thinking, temperature=1.0, top-p=0.95, top-k=20, presence penalty=1.5. For a fair comparison, MARS uses the same unlabeled reference data as ProtoLLM, with R = 5 R=5 queries executed per task. Appendices B and C provide the fixed data protocol and implementation settings.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 在主要实验中,我们使用有高强度思维的DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731作为主干LLM. 我们还使用Quen3.5-4B和Quen3.5-9B来比较MARS与Direct,与原生思维,温度=1.0,上-p=0.95,上-k=20,存在罚分=1.5. 为了进行公平的比较,MARS使用与ProtoLLM相同的无标签参考数据,每个任务执行的R=5 R=5个查询. 附录B和C提供固定数据协议和执行设置。

blocks.en: Figure 3 (a,b) compares the average predictive performance and API costs of different methods across the eight tasks. We account for actual token consumption based on the official DeepSeek API peak-hour pricing. The average task cost of MARS is 0.564 yuan, amounting to only 9.6% of ProtoLLM and lower than Direct’s 1.065 yuan, while achieving higher average AUC and AP. The LLM queries of MARS are concentrated exclusively in the predictor construction stage; once constructed, new samples can be processed via local computation without additional LLM calls.
blocks.zh: 图3(a,b)比较了8项任务中不同方法的平均预测性能和API成本。 根据官方的DeepSeek API高峰时段定价,我们计算出实际象征性消费。 MARS的平均任务成本为0.564人民币,仅相当于ProtoLLM的9.6%并低于Direct的1.065人民币,同时实现了较高的平均AUC和AP. MARS的LLM查询完全集中在预测器构造阶段;一旦建成,新的样本可以通过局部计算处理,而无需额外的LLM调用.

blocks.en: Figure 3 (c) further analyzes the impact of the number of responses R R . For each R R , we evaluate all subsets of size R R from the existing five responses and report the average performance. Increasing the number of responses from 1 to 5 increases the mean AUC and AP by 0.53 and 0.89 percentage points, respectively, with diminishing gains for larger R R .
blocks.zh: 图3(c)进一步分析了答复数目的影响。 对于每个RR,我们从现有的5个答复中评价所有大小R的子集,并报告平均业绩. 将答复数量从1个增加到5个,使平均AUC和AP分别增加0.53和0.89个百分点,而较大的RR的增益正在减少。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 4.2 examines the roles of feature weights, multi-response aggregation, and support strength by uniformly setting feature weights w j w_{j} to 1 1 , using only a single response ( R = 1 R=1 ), and replacing aggregated anchor scores with their signs ( − 1 / 0 / + 1 -1/0/+1 ), respectively. In the support-strength ablation, sign replacement is applied before interpolation or lookup, with feature weights unchanged. Compared to the full MARS, all three settings degrade the average AUC and AP. Removing support strength causes the most pronounced drops, demonstrating that the degree of support conveys predictive information beyond the direction of support.
blocks.zh: 表4.2通过统一设置特征权重w j w_{j}至 1 1 ,仅使用单一的响应(R= 1 R=1),并用其标志(分别为- 1/0/+ 1-1/0/+1)来检查特征权重,多响应汇总和支持强度的作用. 在支持-强的活化中,在插入或取出前会应用符号替换,特征权重不变. 与完整的MARS相比,所有三种设置都使平均AUC和AP降解. 取消支持强度会导致最显著的下降,表明支持的程度传递了超出支持方向的预测信息.

blocks.en: 4.5 Case Study
blocks.zh: 4.5 个案研究

blocks.en: Figure 4: Case study on Bank. Two records are scored using the same cached response functions and feature weights, without further LLM queries.
blocks.zh: 图4:银行案例研究。 使用相同的缓存响应功能和特征权重来打分两种记录,不再进行LLM查询.

blocks.en: Figure 4 illustrates how MARS translates LLM domain priors into feature-level predictive contributions. The same response function assigns support scores of 1.70 and 0.07 to call durations of 633 and 206 seconds, respectively, capturing how specific values affect positive-class support strength. The shared previous outcome, unknown , contributes the same weighted value of − 0.18 -0.18 to both records. These positive and negative contributions combine with those of the other features to produce different final scores. By modeling the direction and strength of value-specific support and combining responses with feature weights, MARS turns the LLM’s semantic judgments into decomposable predictive contributions.
blocks.zh: 图4说明了MARS如何将LLM域名前缀转化为地物级预测贡献. 同样的响应函数指定支持分数为1.70分和0.07分,分别调用持续时间为633秒和206秒,捕捉特定值如何影响正等支持强度. 共同的先前结果(未知)对两个记录的加权值为−0.18-0.18。 这些积极和消极的贡献与其他特点相结合,得出不同的最终分数。 通过模拟特定价值支持的方向和强度,并将响应与特征权重相结合,MARS将LLM的语义判断转化为可分解的预测贡献.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose MARS for zero-label tabular prediction, transforming feature-level LLM priors into response functions and combining them through weighted summation to construct a reusable predictor. Experiments on eight benchmark tasks show that MARS achieves the highest average AUC and AP among the compared methods while remaining cost-efficient. Future work will explore how to reliably incorporate cross-feature interactions to further improve predictive performance.
blocks.zh: 我们建议采用零标签表格预测的MARS,将地物级LLM前缀转换成响应函数,并通过加权总和加以组合来构建可再用预测器. 对8个基准任务的实验表明,MARS在比较方法中实现了最高的平均水平AUC和AP,同时保持了成本效益. 今后的工作将探讨如何可靠地纳入跨地层相互作用,以进一步改善预测性能。

blocks.en: B.1 Datasets and Prediction Tasks
blocks.zh: B.1 数据集和预测性任务

blocks.en: We evaluate MARS on eight binary classification tasks spanning financial services, healthcare, and agriculture. Table 3 summarizes the dataset sizes and feature types. Bank, Blood, Credit-G, Diabetes, Heart, and Myocardial use the processed datasets released with FeatLLM ( Han et al., 2024 ) , retaining their feature names, types, and task questions and mapping no / yes to 0/1. Cultivars and NHANES use their public dataset releases. The prediction tasks and dataset-specific preparation are described below.
blocks.zh: 我们评价关于金融服务、医疗保健和农业的八项二元分类任务。 表3汇总了数据集大小和特征类型. Bank, Blood, Credit-G, Diabetes, Heart, and Myocardial 使用由 FeatLLM(Han等,2024年)发布的已处理数据集,保留了它们的地物名,类型,任务问题并绘制了编号/是为0/1. 种植者和NHANES使用其公共数据集发布. 下文介绍预测任务和具体数据集编制情况。

blocks.en: Table 3: Benchmark sizes. Num./Cat. counts numerical and categorical input features; the target column is excluded.
blocks.zh: 表3:基准规模。 Num./Cat.计算出数字和绝对输入特性;目标列被排除在外.

blocks.en: 1. Bank. A telephone-marketing dataset ( Moro et al., 2011 ) for predicting whether a customer subscribes to a term deposit using customer background and contact records. 2. Blood. A blood-donation dataset ( Yeh et al., 2009 ) for predicting whether an individual donates blood based on past donation records, including donation recency, frequency, and cumulative volume. 3. Credit-G. A credit-assessment dataset ( Hofmann, 1994 ) for classifying individual credit risk using account status, credit history, and loan information. 4. Diabetes. A diabetes classification dataset ( Smith et al., 1988 ) that uses clinical features such as glucose level, body mass index, and age to predict whether a patient has diabetes. 5. Heart. A heart-disease classification dataset ( fedesoriano, 2021 ) that combines clinical features such as chest pain type, blood pressure, and heart rate to predict the presence of heart disease. 6. Cultivars. A dataset of soybean cultivars and field observations ( de Oliveira et al., 2023 ) for predicting whether grain yield ( GY ) exceeds the fixed dataset median of 3397.276724 kg/ha using cultivar information and plant traits. Grain yield itself is excluded from the inputs; Season , Cultivar , and Repetition are categorical features. We split individual observations rather than holding out entire cultivars, so the same cultivar may appear in both the training and test partitions. 7. Myocardial. Clinical records of myocardial infarction patients ( Golovenkin et al., 2020 ) . We use the chronic-heart-failure classification task, with patient history and clinical measurements as inputs, retaining the released history feature ZSN_A . 8. NHANES. A health and nutrition survey dataset ( NA, 2019 ) for predicting whether a participant belongs to the age group of 65 years or older from questionnaire responses, physical examination results, and biochemical measurements. Age ( RIDAGEYR ), the age-group label ( age_group ), and the participant identifier ( SEQN ) are excluded from the inputs.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 银行。 一套电话营销数据集(Moro等,2011年),用以预测客户是否使用客户背景和联系记录订阅定期存款。 2. 血迹。 一套献血数据集(Yeh等人,2009年),用于根据以往的献血记录预测个人是否献血,包括献血复发,出血频率和累计出血量. 3. 信用-G。 一套信用评估数据集(Hofmann,1994年),用于利用账户状况、信用历史和贷款信息对个人信用风险进行分类。 4. 糖尿病。 一个糖尿病分类数据集(Smith等,1988年),该数据集利用了葡萄糖水平,体积指数,年龄等临床特征来预测患者是否有糖尿病. 5. 发心. 心病分类数据集(fedesoriano,2021年)结合了胸痛类型,血压等临床特征,并结合了心率来预测心脏病的存在. 6. 种植者。 一套关于大豆栽培物和野外观测的数据集(de Oliveira等,2023年),用于利用栽培信息和植物特质,预测谷物产量(GY)是否超过3397.276724千克/公顷的固定数据集中位数. 谷物产量本身被排除在投入之外; Season, Cultiar, and repeation是绝对的特征. 我们分开了个别的观察, 而不是把整个栽培植物, 所以同样的栽培植物可能出现在训练 和试验分区。 7.心肌. 心肌梗塞患者临床记录(Golovenkin等,2020年). 我们使用慢性-心衰竭分类任务,将病人的病史和临床测量作为投入,保留了释放的历史特征ZSN_A. 8. 无。 健康与营养调查数据集(NA, 2019),用于从调查问卷答复,物理检查结果,生化测量中预测参与者是否属于65岁或65岁以上年龄组. 年龄(RIDAGEYR),年龄组标签(age_group),以及参与者标识符(SEQN)被排除在输入之外.

blocks.en: Bank. A telephone-marketing dataset ( Moro et al., 2011 ) for predicting whether a customer subscribes to a term deposit using customer background and contact records.
blocks.zh: 银行。 一套电话营销数据集(Moro等,2011年),用以预测客户是否使用客户背景和联系记录订阅定期存款。

blocks.en: Blood. A blood-donation dataset ( Yeh et al., 2009 ) for predicting whether an individual donates blood based on past donation records, including donation recency, frequency, and cumulative volume.
blocks.zh: 血迹. 一套献血数据集(Yeh等人,2009年),用于根据以往的献血记录预测个人是否献血,包括献血复发,出血频率和累计出血量.

blocks.en: Credit-G. A credit-assessment dataset ( Hofmann, 1994 ) for classifying individual credit risk using account status, credit history, and loan information.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-10-21). Credit-G. 一套信用评估数据集(Hofmann,1994年),用于利用账户状况、信用历史和贷款信息对个人信用风险进行分类。

blocks.en: Diabetes. A diabetes classification dataset ( Smith et al., 1988 ) that uses clinical features such as glucose level, body mass index, and age to predict whether a patient has diabetes.
blocks.zh: 糖尿病(原变种). 一个糖尿病分类数据集(Smith等,1988年),该数据集利用了葡萄糖水平,体积指数,年龄等临床特征来预测患者是否有糖尿病.

blocks.en: Heart. A heart-disease classification dataset ( fedesoriano, 2021 ) that combines clinical features such as chest pain type, blood pressure, and heart rate to predict the presence of heart disease.
blocks.zh: 发心. 心病分类数据集(Fedesoriano,2021年)结合了胸痛类型,出血压力等临床特征,并结合了心率来预测心脏病的存在.

blocks.en: Cultivars. A dataset of soybean cultivars and field observations ( de Oliveira et al., 2023 ) for predicting whether grain yield ( GY ) exceeds the fixed dataset median of 3397.276724 kg/ha using cultivar information and plant traits. Grain yield itself is excluded from the inputs; Season , Cultivar , and Repetition are categorical features. We split individual observations rather than holding out entire cultivars, so the same cultivar may appear in both the training and test partitions.
blocks.zh: 耕tiva. 一套关于大豆栽培物和野外观测的数据集(de Oliveira等,2023年),用于利用栽培信息和植物特质,预测谷物产量(GY)是否超过3397.276724千克/公顷的固定数据集中位数. 谷物产量本身被排除在投入之外; Season, Cultiar, and repeation是绝对的特征. 我们分开了个别的观察, 而不是把整个栽培植物, 所以同样的栽培植物可能出现在训练 和试验分区。

blocks.en: Myocardial. Clinical records of myocardial infarction patients ( Golovenkin et al., 2020 ) . We use the chronic-heart-failure classification task, with patient history and clinical measurements as inputs, retaining the released history feature ZSN_A .
blocks.zh: 心经. 心肌梗塞患者临床记录(Golovenkin等,2020年). 我们使用慢性-心衰竭分类任务,将病人的病史和临床测量作为投入,保留所释放的历史特征ZSN_A.

blocks.en: NHANES. A health and nutrition survey dataset ( NA, 2019 ) for predicting whether a participant belongs to the age group of 65 years or older from questionnaire responses, physical examination results, and biochemical measurements. Age ( RIDAGEYR ), the age-group label ( age_group ), and the participant identifier ( SEQN ) are excluded from the inputs.
blocks.zh: 无。 健康与营养调查数据集(NA, 2019),用于从调查问卷答复,物理检查结果,生化测量中预测参与者是否属于65岁或65岁以上年龄组. 年龄(RIDAGEYR),年龄组标签(age_group),以及参与者标识符(SEQN)被排除在输入之外.

blocks.en: B.2 Splits, Label Access, and Metrics
blocks.zh: B.2 分块、标签存取和计量

blocks.en: We use an 80/20 stratified split with random seed 0. From the training partition, two examples per class are reserved for the four-label comparators. The remaining training features form the unlabeled reference pool. The same support examples and test records are shared by the methods. For test partitions larger than 800 rows, we sample approximately 800 rows proportionally by class with seed 0; unused test records are not moved into the reference pool. Table 3 gives the resulting evaluation sizes, totaling 2,146 records.
blocks.zh: 我们使用80/20分级分出 随机种子0。 从训练分区中,每班有两个例子保留给四个标签的参照人. 其余的培训功能构成无标签的参考库。 同样的支持实例和测试记录被方法共享. 对于大于800行的测试分区,我们按等级按比例抽取了大约800行的种子0;未使用的测试记录不移入参考池. 表3列出了评价的规模,共计2 146个记录。

blocks.en: Labels are used by the evaluator to define the split, select the four comparator examples, and compute metrics. MARS receives only the task question and reference features. Its prompt, anchor selection, aggregation, and prediction do not access support or test labels. The comparison uses no additional labeled validation set.
blocks.zh: 标签被评价者用来定义分数,选择四个比较国的例子,并计算度量. MARS只接收任务问题和参考特征. 它的即时,锁定选择,聚合,和预测不能访问支持或测试标签. 该比较没有使用附加标签的验证集.

blocks.en: We compute ROC-AUC and average precision from the continuous prediction scores and average task-level metrics with equal task weights. The main table reports this fixed split. The five elicitation responses are repeated LLM requests, not five data-split seeds. For response-count sensitivity, every subset of size R R from the five cached responses is evaluated, first averaging over subsets within each task and then over tasks. The single-response ablation averages the five one-response models.
blocks.zh: 我们计算ROC-AUC和平均精度,从连续预测分数和平均任务级别测量值中计算,任务权重相同。 主表报告这种固定分拆. 5个诱导反应是重复的LLM请求,而不是5个数据分裂的种子. 就响应计数敏感性而言,对五个缓存响应中每个大小R的子集进行评估,首先对每项任务中每个子集进行平均评价,然后对任务进行平均评价。 单应答平均为5个单应答模型.

blocks.en: Appendix C Hyperparameters and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 超参数和执行细节

blocks.en: C.1 MARS Construction Settings
blocks.zh: C.1 MARS 建筑设置

blocks.en: The construction settings in Table 4 are shared by the eight tasks and three backbones. MARS constructs response functions by aggregation and interpolation and elicits feature weights from the LLM, without a task-specific optimizer, learning rate, or training schedule. For each feature, we aggregate valid replies whose score vectors contain exactly one finite value per anchor.
blocks.zh: 表4中的建设设置由8项任务和3个骨干共享. MARS通过聚合和内插构建响应功能,并从LLM中引出特征权重,没有特定任务优化器,学习率或培训时间表. 对于每个特性,我们汇总有效答复,其分数矢量包含每个锚一个精确的有限值。

blocks.en: Table 4: MARS construction settings used in the reported experiments.
blocks.zh: 表4:报告实验中使用的MARS构建设置。

blocks.en: C.2 LLM Generation Settings
blocks.zh: C.2 LLM 生成设置

blocks.en: Table 5 records the generation settings for MARS. DeepSeek uses the API model identifier deepseek-v4-flash , recorded as DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 in the experiment. Thinking is enabled with high reasoning effort and JSON-object output. Temperature and top- p p were not explicitly set in these requests. Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B use their native thinking template with the same sampling settings as each other.
blocks.zh: 表5记录了MARS的生成设置. DeepSeek使用API模型标识符deepSeek-v4-flash. 在实验中被记录为DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731. 思维通过高推理努力和JSON-对象输出而启用. 这些请求中没有明确设置温度和最高p。 Quen3.5-4B和Quen3.5-9B使用各自具有相同采样设置的本土思维模板.

blocks.en: Table 5: MARS generation settings. “Not set” means the request contains no override for that parameter.
blocks.zh: 表5:MARS生成设置. “未设定”是指请求中未包含对该参数的覆盖。

blocks.en: Qwen inference uses bfloat16, tensor parallel size 1, engine seed 0, a maximum context length of 81,920 tokens, and GPU-memory utilization 0.92. The engine allows at most 8 sequences and 4,096 batched tokens, with chunked prefill and prefix caching enabled.
blocks.zh: Quen推论使用bfloat16,拉诺平行尺寸1,引擎种子0,最大上下文长度为81,920个符,和GPU-memory 利用率0.92. 引擎最多允许8个序列和4,096个批发的活字,并启用了块状的预填和前缀活字箱.
